errors.AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Invalid username or password. Try again.
errors.AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Your role cannot perform this action (403).
errors.CSRF_FAILED: Security check failed. Reload or sign in again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Resource not found or endpoint not available yet. Retry or contact an administrator.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check your input and try again.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: File exceeds 10 MB or 10 pages. Reduce and upload again.
errors.FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: Only PDF, PNG and JPEG are supported. Choose another file.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: Document is still processing. Try again shortly.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: Record already exists. Check and retry.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait before retrying.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Processing quota reached. Contact an administrator.
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Model unavailable; real LLM verification was not completed. Try later. No rule-engine fake answer is shown.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Processing failed. Retry and provide the request ID.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Connection failed. Check the network and backend, then retry.
errors.PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Waiting timed out; the job may still be running. Reopen from the list instead of uploading again.
errors.STREAM_INTERRUPTED: Answer disconnected and history recovery failed. Your question was not resent. Reopen later.

audit.serviceUnavailable: Service unavailable (503). When the rate-limit store fails, writes are refused—never silently allowed.

models.noLlm: This response has no healthy LLM entry (every healthy flag is false). It does not rewrite degrade_level or stored extraction, review, or chat records.
degrade.scope.extraction: Degrade fields on this recognition. Not current system health, and not the review or chat result.
degrade.scope.review: Degrade fields on this report. Not current system health, and not the extraction or chat result.
degrade.scope.chat: This message has model traces only. It has no degrade level, so the level is unconfirmed. System health and the report level are not copied here.
degrade.scope.system: Current /system/models health. Not the provenance of a stored report, extraction, or message.
degrade.source.localCaveat: The local model name comes from this response. It is not an accepted capability.
degrade.limit.L0: Cloud model. This response is marked L0 only. It does not show that other capabilities match.
degrade.limit.L1: Backup cloud model. This response is marked L1 only. It does not show that other capabilities match, and it is not an offline capability.
degrade.limit.L2: This response is marked L2. It is not an accepted offline capability and does not mean a complete offline workflow is available.
degrade.limit.L3: Rules engine. Human review is required.
degrade.limit.unconfirmed: Degrade level is unconfirmed. A model name, system health, or another capability is not treated as success.
degrade.limit.inconsistent: The level and the source disagree. Both stay as returned and neither is rewritten. This is not an accepted offline capability.
degrade.positioning: Product positioning (not a measurement on this page): cloud model primary, rules engine as fallback. L2 is not shown as an accepted offline capability.
degrade.blocked: This message was blocked and has no degrade level.
